summary: Frontend-only regression-light test of the new Picks board (desktop 1920x900, Bearer/cookie session qa-test-token-123) plus a curl verification of GET /api/picks. Nav renders exactly 5 tabs in the requested order and 'Picks' routes to /picks. Picks page renders title, record strip (1 Won / 0 Lost / 17 Pending / 100% with '1/1 settled'), 18 pick-card elements grouped by date, correct badges/fixture/league+kickoff/status chips, and 1 pick-result ('10 corners' for Feyenoord 5+). 'Refresh results' button clickable, shows success toast 'Checking latest results — updating in ~15s…', no console errors, no error elements. API returns record {won:1,lost:0,pending:17,total:18,settled:1,win_rate:100.0} and 18 picks all containing team, line, home, away, league_name, status, result_corners, kickoff. No issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: Picks.jsx settle(): the button is force-locked in 'Checking…' state for a fixed 15s setTimeout; if the component unmounts the timer still fires (setState on unmounted component). Minor — consider clearing the timeout on unmount.
Picks.jsx load() swallows errors with .catch(() => {}) — a failed /api/picks call shows an empty 'No picks tracked yet.' state instead of an error state.
seed_data_creation: None; used existing qa-user-1 session token and the 18 seeded picks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Picks tab verified end-to-end on desktop. Settle endpoint has a 120s throttle — avoid repeated clicks. Other tabs (Value Finder, Quick Scan, Leagues, Streaks) were not re-tested this iteration; see iterations 1-5.
